# Devmora Technology

> Devmora Technology is a senior-led web and app development company based in Greater Noida, India. We build websites, web apps, SaaS products, e-commerce stores and React Native mobile apps with React, Next.js, Node.js and AWS for businesses in the UK, USA, Canada and Australia.

- Founder and lead developer: Abhimanyu Rai
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +91 80929 52307, or the form at https://devmoratech.com/contact (reply within 24 hours)
- Working hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 19:00 India time (IST)
- Clients own all code, designs, domains and accounts from day one

## Services

- [All services](https://devmoratech.com/services): Website and web app development, SaaS, e-commerce, mobile apps, SEO and cloud support
- [SaaS development](https://devmoratech.com/saas-development): MVP to scale, multi-tenant apps, subscriptions, roles and integrations
- [Mobile app development](https://devmoratech.com/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android apps in React Native, plus the dashboards and APIs behind them
- [Transport management system development](https://devmoratech.com/transport-management-system-development): Custom TMS and driver apps for UK hauliers: jobs, walkaround checks, defect tracking and compliance reminders
- [E-commerce and marketplace development](https://devmoratech.com/ecommerce-development): Custom online stores and multi-vendor marketplaces
- [Hire React developers](https://devmoratech.com/hire-react-developers): Dedicated React.js and Next.js developers from India
- [Hire Node.js developers](https://devmoratech.com/hire-nodejs-developers): Dedicated Node.js and Express developers for APIs, SaaS backends and integrations
- [Offshore web development](https://devmoratech.com/offshore-web-development): A dedicated offshore development team in India for businesses and agencies

## Markets served

- [United Kingdom](https://devmoratech.com/web-development-uk): UK GDPR-aware builds, UK-hours calls, AWS London hosting
- [United States](https://devmoratech.com/web-development-usa): MVP and SaaS development for US startups, ADA-aware builds
- [Canada](https://devmoratech.com/web-development-canada): Bilingual English/French apps, PIPEDA and CASL-aware builds
- [Australia](https://devmoratech.com/web-development-australia): Privacy Act-aware builds, AWS Sydney hosting, AEST afternoon calls

## Portfolio

- [Work](https://devmoratech.com/work): All live projects
- Accukount Pharma: stock verification SaaS for Canadian pharmacies, with web dashboards and English/French iOS and Android apps
- AssetKount: enterprise asset lifecycle and verification platform
- Midland Commercials: used truck marketplace for a UK dealer, with an AI sales assistant and server-rendered SEO listings
- BRIT Commercials: website and admin panel for a Derby-based HGV dealer
- Transport management system and driver app for a UK haulage business
- Hospital management system for clinics and small hospitals
- Sellaids: multi-vendor e-commerce platform with vendor panels and a React storefront
